# Tender response -- KVK-TEK-2026/11

Visakoivu Oy

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy has completed several comparable reference projects within the last five years, satisfying the requirement.

3.2 Visakoivu's turnover in its most recent financial year is above the required EUR 5,000,000 threshold.

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio comfortably exceeds the required 20%.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Routine maintenance visits at each school property are scheduled on a regular calendar, with content tailored to the systems present at each site and agreed with the contracting authority.

4.2 A preventive maintenance plan is proposed for all systems covered by this agreement, reviewed annually with the contracting authority and updated as school usage changes.

4.4 The asset register and supporting documentation will be handed over to the contracting authority at the start and end of the contract, in an agreed format.

4.5 Energy-efficiency measures will be implemented and monitored across the properties covered by this agreement, with findings reported periodically.

4.6 Fault reports receive a prompt response, supported by a standby (on-call) arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, so that schools are not left without cover outside normal hours.

4.7 A commissioning and testing procedure follows any repair or installation work, with sign-off recorded before handover and a copy of the test results kept on file for the contracting authority.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 A discount structure is offered against the overall volume of the framework agreement.

5.2 Visakoivu's proposed payment terms follow normal commercial practice for agreements of this kind.

5.3 We accept a bonus/malus arrangement tied to the service levels set out in Section 4.

5.4 Visakoivu's standard limitation-of-liability clause applies to this agreement, in line with our normal commercial terms.

## 6. Forms to be enclosed

6.1 CVs of the key personnel proposed for delivery of the contract are enclosed.

## 7. Format requirements

7.2 All monetary figures in this tender are rounded to two decimal places.

## Liite A

A.1 Personnel working on school premises meet our standard qualification requirements for technical and safety competence on occupied educational sites.

A.2 We propose training sessions for the contracting authority's own property staff on the systems maintained under this agreement, delivered on site.

A.4 Refrigeration equipment (F-gas) in school kitchens is maintained in line with F-gas regulation requirements, with logs kept for each unit.

## Liite B

B.1 Visakoivu accepts the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met.
